_comment: Single source of truth for which gateways the compat suite runs against.
Read by the `compat` matrix in ci.yml and by the compat sweep, and edited
by the sweep's automated bump PR. Per ADR 0005 the SDK pin in
backend/go.mod and these pins move together in one change.
PRs test the PIN and nothing else. Looking around — at newer releases — is
the scheduled sweep's job, not every PR's. Adding an advisory lane here is
possible but should be deliberate: a lane pinned to an older release can
never go green, because the SDK only moves forward.
floor: the gateway the dashboard is pinned to.
floor_release: the newest RELEASED version at or below the pin. While the
pin is an unreleased dev build these differ; see ADR 0005.
